popup.markHint: mark as learned in the bar
panel.title: Shortcut Trainer
panel.empty: No shortcuts found. Your Hyprland bindings may not have descriptions.
panel.footer: Click a shortcut to mark it learned. Middle-click the icon for a tip, right-click to pause.
rule.term-split: Switch the split between horizontal and vertical
rule.term-focus: Move focus to the neighbouring window
rule.term-tmux: Open a new terminal with Tmux
rule.browser-width: Stretch the window to full width
rule.browser-popout: Pop the window out (float and pin)
rule.file-cwd: File manager in the terminal's folder
rule.editor-swap: Swap the window with its neighbour
rule.all-move-ws: Move the window to a workspace
panel.freshNote: These shortcuts arrived with an Omarchy update or a new binding. They come first as tips.
settings.gapSeconds: At least this long between tips
settings.note: Tips come when you switch apps. Saved in ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json.
